thread:
Ana M: quick sync — final sprint on the Arclight customer spotlight. need 3 things locked today: quote sign-off, asset handoff to growth, and final rights check. timeline: post + webinar excerpt next tues.

Tom S: got it. I pushed latest transcript + short pull quotes here: https://drive.redwood/Arclight/spotlight-v3 (see 'approved_quotes' sheet) :point_right:

Jess R: reviewing now. two small nits on the hero quote — can we ask the customer to shorten to one sentence?

Ana M: yes — @Tom S can you send a slack nudge to Mira at Arclight to tighten the quote? keep original in doc as backup.

Tom S: pinged Mira just now: "Hey Mira — quick ask: could you condense your quote to a single sentence for the launch post? ideally 20–25 words. no pressure."

Mira (customer) (via email import): happy to — here's a tightened line: "Redwood cut our inference costs in half and gave us predictable latency at scale."

Jess R: that reads great. moving to approvals flow: legal needs a signed opt-in for quote + assets release. @Legal Team can you confirm the template link to send?

Legal Team: use release-template-v2. added comments on the doc for creative usage (social, blog, webinar). upload signed copy to the same Drive folder. ETA EOD today.

Liam P: for inbound routing — once live, can we route demo requests from the Arclight post to the dedicated webinar signup? prefer to tag them as "post-arclight" for follow-up. who sets that up?

Ana M: @Liam P — can you coordinate with growth ops? need a UTM + lead tag. also add a hidden conversion funnel for webinar attendees.

Liam P: created a short spec and shared in #growth-ops. UTM: source=arclight_spotlight, campaign=arclight_launch_2026. tagging rule added to leadflow.

Jess R: final content check — hero tweet + thread ready. small edit to CTA on webinar card. proposed CTA: "Join our live breakdown of the Arclight integration — Wed 10am PT. Register -> [link]".

Ana M: looks good. last piece: mic check for webinar assets — we need 30/60 sec video clips and 2 pull quotes formatted for linkedin. @Tom S can you prod the customer for the short clip?

Tom S: requested clip + confirm recording rights. used legal template language: "Redwood gets perpetual, non-exclusive rights to use in marketing channels" — customer agreed. added signed checkbox to Drive.

deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled post staging deployment at 2026-05-05T14:00Z. please confirm content is final 24h before.

Ana M: OK -- if Legal uploads signed release by EOD and Jess finalizes assets by tomorrow noon, we hit that deploy. thanks everyone. :tada:
